title: Account Opening and Starter Entry Requirements for Pocketwire Pay in 4
content:
An account can be applied for only by a customer whose personal account is active on Pocketwire Core or a higher plan; the eligibility check approves it on Pocketwire Pay in 4 Starter when the Starter entry requirements are met and declines it otherwise, and a representative cannot approve it or raise its spending power.

This is the Pocketwire Pay in 4 account opening rule issued by the credit team. The personal account it refers to is the customer's Pocketwire Personal Account linked to the Pay in 4 application.

### Who may apply

The right to apply rests on the system record of the linked Pocketwire Personal Account — its status and its plan as shown on the account itself — checked before the application is registered:

- the personal account's status is active; and
- the personal account is on Pocketwire Core or a higher plan.

A personal account in any other status, or on a plan below Pocketwire Core, does not give the right to apply.

### Starter entry requirements

Every approved account starts on Pocketwire Pay in 4 Starter. The eligibility check approves the account when all of the Starter entry requirements are met:

| Starter entry requirement | Required |
|---|---|
| Plan of the linked personal account | Pocketwire Core at least |
| Age of the customer | 18 years at least |
| Linked debit card on file | Yes |

If any one of them is not met, the eligibility check declines the account.

### Outcome of the eligibility check

| All Starter entry requirements met? | Outcome | Status of the Pocketwire Pay in 4 account |
|---|---|---|
| Yes | Approved on Pocketwire Pay in 4 Starter | applied, then active |
| No | Declined | applied, then closed, with the decline date recorded as the closing date |

The approval and the decline are both made by the eligibility check itself. A representative cannot approve an account the check has not approved and cannot raise the spending power of an account.

### What the records show at opening

When the customer applies, the Pocketwire Pay in 4 account is recorded under the customer and the linked personal account with the application date, the tier Pocketwire Pay in 4 Starter, an amount owed of USD 0.00, zero plans paid on time, and the date of its first tier review.

### Illustrations (hypothetical applicants)

- A customer aged 25 whose linked personal account is active on Pocketwire Core and who has a linked debit card on file may apply, and the eligibility check approves the account on Pocketwire Pay in 4 Starter.
- A customer aged 25 whose linked personal account is active on Pocketwire Core but who has no linked debit card on file may apply, and the eligibility check declines the account.
- A customer whose personal account is not active cannot apply, whatever the plan of that account.
